name: Doxy.me vs TherapyNotes
title: Doxy.me vs TherapyNotes: Standalone Telehealth vs Full EHR Comparison
description: Compare Doxy.me (free HIPAA telehealth) and TherapyNotes (mental health EHR). Understand when to use dedicated telehealth vs an all-in-one practice management solution.

summary.bottom_line: Doxy.me is a standalone HIPAA-compliant telehealth platform with a free tier. TherapyNotes is a complete mental health EHR with telehealth included. Choose Doxy.me if you only need video visits (or want free telehealth); choose TherapyNotes if you need scheduling, billing, documentation, and client portal with telehealth included.

key_differences.free_option: Doxy.me (free tier) vs TherapyNotes (no free tier)

sections.heading: Doxy.me vs TherapyNotes: Overview
sections.content: Doxy.me and TherapyNotes serve very different purposes. Doxy.me is a focused telehealth platform—it provides HIPAA-compliant video visits with a genuinely free tier used by over 1 million providers. TherapyNotes is a comprehensive mental health EHR with scheduling, billing, documentation, client portal, 24/7 support, and integrated telehealth. The choice depends on whether you need just video capability or complete practice management.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: Doxy.me's free tier provides unlimited 1:1 HIPAA-compliant video calls—exceptional value for telehealth-only needs. Paid plans ($35-65/month) add group sessions and branding. TherapyNotes costs $69/month per clinician including telehealth, scheduling, billing, and 24/7 support. For telehealth alone, Doxy.me free wins. For complete practice management with telehealth included, TherapyNotes at $69/month is competitive.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: Doxy.me provides: browser-based video, HIPAA compliance on free tier, virtual waiting room, group sessions (paid), screen sharing, and custom branding (paid). TherapyNotes provides: integrated telehealth, appointment scheduling with reminders, electronic insurance claims, progress notes with mental health templates, treatment plans, client portal (TherapyPortal), and 24/7 customer support. Doxy.me does one thing excellently; TherapyNotes manages your entire practice.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your practice needs:

recommendations.when: You only need telehealth, want a free HIPAA option, or have a separate EHR and just need to add video visits
You need complete practice management (scheduling, billing, notes, portal) with telehealth included—TherapyNotes replaces multiple tools
Rarely needed—TherapyNotes includes telehealth. Only add Doxy.me if you specifically prefer its video experience over TherapyNotes Telehealth

faqs.q: Can I use Doxy.me instead of TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Only if you don't need practice management. Doxy.me provides telehealth only—no scheduling, billing, documentation, or client portal. Most therapy practices need an EHR like TherapyNotes; Doxy.me is just for video.

faqs.q: Is TherapyNotes telehealth as good as Doxy.me?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes Telehealth is functional and convenient because it integrates with scheduling and notes. Doxy.me is a dedicated telehealth platform, so some find its video experience better. For most practices, TherapyNotes' integrated telehealth is sufficient.

faqs.q: Should I use both Doxy.me and TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Usually not necessary—TherapyNotes includes telehealth. Some practices use Doxy.me for video (especially the free tier) while using TherapyNotes for practice management, but this means managing two systems.
TherapyNotes offers 24/7 live customer support, which is exceptional in the industry. Doxy.me has standard support. If support is important to you, TherapyNotes has the advantage.
